llm.guidance: Before installing, consider narrowing or disabling implicit invocation so the skill only runs when explicitly requested for SkillScan-style security workflow help. The inspected artifact is otherwise a low-impact guidance skill rather than a code-executing or data-accessing package.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: The scanner's broad-trigger concern is supported by the artifact text and agents/openai.yaml allow_implicit_invocation setting, but the artifact has no high-impact capabilities or hidden behavior, so this supports user caution rather than a Review verdict.
